text: Alright hockey faithful, settle in because things are as tight as a penalty kill with two minutes left in the third!  Green Jackets and Mon-Q are locked in a dead heat for first, while LMD is just a hair behind them, proving that sometimes, no movement is the biggest movement of all when the competition is this fierce.  The biggest shake-up we saw was Mattress Dobes leaping up one spot to eighth, likely thanks to Tristan Scandar's lineup magic, while some of the usual suspects like JeE-DeY and Pastaboy are feeling the squeeze as teams jostle for position.  Keep an eye on Francis Barrière and Torida Té next week, because if they keep trading punches like this, we might need to bring in a referee to sort out the standings.
